title: A Phone Call, a Newspaper Advert and Sabin's First Room in Brasília
conflicts: Equipment instalments: six (Correio Braziliense 2022) vs ten (InfoMoney 2024), both Vaz's accounts; both given. Opening staff: three (Sabin 2011 report, Saúde Business 2012, Correio 2022/2025) vs four (NSC Total 2025, a sponsored Metrópoles feature); story uses three. First room: Edifício de Clínicas in Asa Norte near HRAN (founders' own account) vs next to the Hospital Regional de Taguatinga (Nosso Meio, not cited); story follows the founders.
notes: Accreditation kept exact: the 2011 report shows a management system on ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001:2004 and PALC (SBPC) with external audits (PALC audit October 2011), but gives no first-accreditation year, so the story says 'by 2011'; CAP accreditation was reported by Medicina S/A on 19 February 2020 after a November 2019 audit. Two founder sources are sponsored content (Correio 'Parceiros: Sabin', InfoMoney MoneyLab); they are used for the founders' own recollections and attributed. Founders' Portuguese is paraphrased, not quoted. This is the one talQen mention in the group.
